decision.detection_floor: 10 x the largest of the precision error and the repeat difference on development cells, for states and readouts separately; a response counts as detected only above it
decision.first_order: embed channel only: per site, the share of confirmatory cells passing, and the cell-mean slopes
decision.reference: each site's response placed within the random-site distribution (descriptive, no threshold)

declaration.name: teddy_mm_forward_typed_events
declaration.exploratory_reason: Designed after the sealed inverse runs located a loss in the head; it asks how gene-level sources propagate step by step and how the head's protein readout responds. Exploratory evidence (ANM paper p. 8).

baseline.sizes_reason: compute budget (about 2 x 22,000 TEDDY forward passes, roughly an hour on the MacBook Pro), fixed now

random.from: genes in TEDDY's vocabulary that are tokens in >= 90% of development cells

record: number of tokens whose position moves

events.skip: a site with zero count (count channel), not among the cell's tokens (embed channel), or outside TEDDY's vocabulary (both) is skipped in that cell; skips are counted and reported per site

controls.repeat: each development cell's baseline is run twice in the run's precision; reported as a determinism check
controls.precision: each development cell is also run in float64 on the CPU; the largest float32-vs-float64 difference is the numerical error of one forward pass

measurements.state_metric: relative displacement |dh| / |h|; Frobenius norm over real tokens for input and layers
measurements.readout: head output log mean for the declared proteins, and the norm of the change over all 134

reporting: per site and channel: propagation profile over steps, readout response, step check, skips
the count channel's rank shifts, admissions and moved tokens: that is how the source reaches TEDDY; counts are scaled before normalization, so a scaled count need not be an integer
z_direction: the head's response to the measured knockout direction, placed among the random directions
state and readout responses side by side; no gain decomposition beyond the linear case; a joint change is association under intervention, not mediation (SI S1.3)
a model readout, not a measurement: this half says how the model responds, not whether a state is sufficient

exploratory_reason: Designed after the sealed inverse runs located a loss in the head; it asks how gene-level sources propagate step by step and how the head's protein readout responds. Exploratory evidence (ANM paper p. 8).

routing_check.rule: the scaled count never reaches TEDDY: tokens identical, and state and readout change no larger than the repeat-level numerics (identical inputs in another batch position)
routing_check.chosen_from: genes outside TEDDY's vocabulary that the confirmatory cells express (an unexpressed gene's count cannot be scaled, so its control would be empty)
